title: Starbucks Corporation Commences Cash Tender Offers for Eight Series of Notes
summary: Starbucks Corporation (Nasdaq: SBUX) (“ Starbucks ,” “ we ,” “ us ” or the “ Company ”) today announced the commencement of tender offers to purchase (each offer a “ Tender Offer ” and collectively, the “ Tender Offers ”), subject to the terms and conditions of the Tender Offers described the Offer to Purchase dated May 4, 2026 (the “ Offer to Purchase ”), in the order of priority set forth in the table below (the “ Acceptance Priority Level ”) for an Aggregate Purchase Price of up to $1.1 billion, as may be increased or decreased by the Company in accordance with applicable law (the “ Aggregate Cap ”), in cash from each registered holder of the applicable series of Notes (each, a “ Holder ” and, collectively, the “ Holders ”), consisting of: (i) up to $500 million Aggregate Purchase Price (the “ Pool 1 Maximum Amount ”) of its 4.800% Senior Notes due 2030, its 4.500% Senior Notes due 2028 and its 4.000% Senior Notes due 2028 (collectively, the “ Pool 1 Notes ”) in the priorities set
